transcript.text: Hi everyone. We've got the 70-minute picture-locked master exported and ready for final approval. Before I can sign off and authorize delivery to the festival, we need to run through our standard round-robin sign-off procedure. I need Quality Control and Accessibility to each report their sign-off requirements so we can get this locked and delivered in time for the festival premiere next month. Who's ready to go first?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I need to flag a critical QC issue before we proceed. Yesterday I tested the exported master against the festival's actual projection server, and I found that the 5.1 audio mapping drops the center dialogue channel. The festival requires a 2.0 PCM master for this server. I completed this test after the latest export, so the shared delivery checklist hasn't been updated to reflect this yet. This needs to be resolved before I can sign off on the master.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I need to flag an accessibility requirement that isn't on the current checklist. This morning I reviewed the festival's accessibility bulletin, and the premiere package must include both open captions and a separate audio-description track. The bulletin arrived after the package was circulated for sign-off, so I haven't been able to update the accessibility checklist yet. This needs to be added to the delivery package before I can sign off.
transcript.speaker: A3

transcript.text: Thank you both for flagging these issues. Let me make sure I understand what needs to happen before I can authorize delivery. Elias, you're telling me the festival's projection server requires a 2.0 PCM master, and our current 5.1 audio mapping drops the center dialogue channel — so we need to re-export with correct 2.0 PCM audio. Nora, you're telling me the festival's accessibility bulletin requires both open captions and a separate audio-description track in the premiere package, and neither is currently included. Both of these are critical blockers that need to be resolved before sign-off. Can each of you confirm the scope of work and timeline needed to address your respective issues? We need to move quickly given the festival premiere is next month.
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: Thanks, Morgan. Let me confirm the scope on the QC side. The issue is specifically with the audio format: our current master has 5.1 audio mapping that drops the center dialogue channel, and the festival's projection server requires a 2.0 PCM master. So the scope of work is a re-export of the master with a correct 2.0 PCM audio mix that preserves the center dialogue channel. I've already confirmed the requirement by testing against the actual festival server, so there's no ambiguity about the spec — we just need the re-export done. On timeline, I'd need to re-test the new export against the festival server once it's ready, and I can turn that around within a day of receiving the re-exported file. I can't sign off until that test passes.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: Thanks, Morgan. Let me confirm the scope on the accessibility side. The festival's accessibility bulletin requires two deliverables that are not currently in the package: open captions and a separate audio-description track. The scope of work is creating and integrating both of these into the premiere package. I've already confirmed the requirements by reviewing the bulletin directly, so there's no ambiguity about what's needed. On timeline, I'll need to update the accessibility checklist, verify that both the open captions and audio-description track meet the festival's specifications, and confirm they're properly included in the final package. I can turn around my verification within a day of receiving the updated package with both deliverables integrated. I can't sign off until both the open captions and the separate audio-description track are confirmed in the delivery package.
transcript.speaker: A3
